## Cherum (CR 22)

**XP** 615,000  
 N(E) Colossal aberration (fire)  
 **Init** +8; **Senses** darkvision 120 ft.; Perception +45; **Aura** fiery aura (40 ft., 6d6 fire, DC 36)  

**Defense**

 **AC** 37, touch 7, flat-footed 32 (+4 Dex, +1 dodge, +30 natural, –8 size)  
 **hp** 612 (36d8+324); fast healing 15 when touching fire  
 **Fort** +24; **Ref** +18; **Will** +24  
 **DR** 15/epic; **Immune** fire, poison; **SR** 33  
 **Weaknesses** vulnerability to cold  

**Offense**

 **Speed** 30 ft.  
 **Melee** bite +34 (4d8+14/19-20 plus 2d6 fire plus grab), 2 claws +33 (3d6+14/19-20 plus 2d6 fire)  
 **Space** 30 ft.; **Reach** 30 ft.  
 **Special Attacks** swallow whole (3d6+14 plus 2d6 fire damage, AC 25, 45 hp)  

**Statistics**

 **Str** 39, **Dex** 18, **Con** 26, **Int** 12, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 12  
 **Base Atk** +27; **CMB** +49 (+53 bull rush, grapple); **CMD** 64 (68 bull rush)  
 **Feats** Alertness, Awesome Blow, Cleave, [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), Great Cleave, Greater Bull Rush, Improved Bull Rush, Improved Critical (bite, claw), Improved Initiative, Improved Lightning Reflexes, Intimidating Prowess, Iron Will, Lightning Reflexes, Vital Strike, [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md), [Great Fortitude](../../rules/feats/great-fortitude.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility; Diehard and Endurance are one feat, Toughness; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite), Great Fortitude.*  
 **Skills** Climb +53, Bluff +20, Intimidate +54, Knowledge (religion) +22, Perception +45, Sense Motive +24 Survival +23  
 **Languages** Common, Giant  

**Special Abilities**

 **Fast Healing (Ex)** A cherum heals only if it is touching a flame or lava pool that covers at least an area equal to its space (30-foot area).  

**Ecology**

**Environment** warm mountains  
 **Organization** solitary  
 **Treasure** double
